newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen remaining firm on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen remaining firm on Wall Street.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen remaining firm on Wednesday after a sharp rise on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
They, however, said reports that the government expected to issue a regulation banning big retailers from entering markets in regencies was seen dampening sentiment in retailers.

"Generally I think the market will remain firm today, but sentiment on the big retailers like Matahari is likely to be weak after newspaper reports that the government would ban them from entering small town markets," one broker said.
The broker said local speculators were likely remain active, particularly in small-sized property firm Elang Realty on market talk of a possible rights issue.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index rose 3.98 points, or 0.62 percent, to close at 646.24 points.
"The consortium is interested to buy a large stake in the firm in order to become a dominant player in the transportation industry," another broker said.
Steady Safe officials were not immediately available for comment.
Heavyweight cigarette firms Gudang Garam and Sampoerna continued making gains as the stocks were considered to have bottomed out, brokers said.
